checks.reviewed: Implementation, tests, report scalar receipts, PISA comparison and arithmetic recomputation. No full-rank GPU implementation or quality measurement.

algebra.raw_complement: Count, sum K, sum V and sum V(KU)^T are additive. Inclusion-exclusion removes two overlapping cell-aligned rectangles once, and register IDs outside rectangles are deduplicated. Recenter only after raw subtraction.
algebra.within_cell_h: H_j U = sum_i v_i(k_i U)^T - sum_i v_i mean_i(k_i U)^T. Cell prefixes add these unnormalized within-cell moments. The mean over complete complementary cells is the intended PISA-style object.
algebra.different_objects: Single-cloud covariance equals mean within-cell covariance plus covariance of cell means for equal-size cells. It cannot substitute for mean within-cell H without the between-cell term. Tests independently verify this identity.
algebra.whole_cell_restrictions: Within-cell H lookup rejects partial cell edges and register deletions. Raw complement supports registers, but that does not establish within-cell H support for partially removed cells.
algebra.floating_point: Real-arithmetic additivity is exact; FP32/FP64 results retain accumulation and cancellation error.

conditioning.fixed_near_full_case: One residual token has exactly zero centered covariance. FP32 raw subtraction and recentering leave a nonzero result, explicitly retained rather than clipped.
conditioning.interpretation: Relative error against a zero reference is undefined. These figures measure the full projection/aggregation/subtraction/recentering path, not subtraction alone. The new within-cell report uses FP64; it does not establish FP32 H stability on pretrained features. The actual-QKV offline report should use direct centered FP64 cells for the numerical reference.

rank8_counterexample.construction: Choose unit w in the orthogonal complement of U, keys [w,-w], values [[1,0],[-1,0]], and q=w. H=V^T K. All feature means are zero.
rank8_counterexample.conclusion: Fixed projected sufficient statistics preserve bookkeeping, but can discard the entire useful correction. Rank8 is not justified for actual operator fidelity and is excluded from the prospective full-rank analysis.

full_rank_analytical_cost.limits: These are per-attention-layer selected operation/storage counts, not end-to-end model memory or speed. H-only 403 MB excludes prefixes, optional complementary supports, QKV, other moments and model tensors. Existing Python prototype retains both raw and centered moments and borrowed K/V; its total resident tensor count is not incremental cache overhead. Grouping 256 queries sharing each cell-local support is prospective and can stream the complement cache. Logical read counts are not measured DRAM traffic; CPU timings and process RSS do not predict GPU latency.

prior_art_boundary.specific_collision: PISA Section 3.3, Equation 8 uses a mean of complementary within-cell H and then substitutes a global mean for efficiency. Retrieving the complementary mean with spatial sums evaluates that known object. It does not create a new moment approximation.
prior_art_boundary.other_established_components: Centered first-order corrections, exact-plus-approximate mass normalization, sufficient-statistic subtraction and spatial prefix sums are established. See attention_measure_independent.json for Scatterbrain, MomentKV and Sol-Attn boundaries.
prior_art_boundary.possible_conditional_contribution: A measured favorable accuracy/cost tradeoff for spatially conditioned H in this particular diffusion attention target could motivate an engineering refinement. Novelty, model-quality preservation and actual speed remain unestablished.

decision.scientific_question: Does the known global-H substitution materially lose accuracy on actual gained post-RoPE attention, and how much remains due to unweighted complementary averaging versus alpha-weighted first-order correction and Taylor/denominator approximation?
decision.why_synthetic_evidence_is_insufficient: Synthetic cases demonstrate both a large selected/global-H mismatch and residual attention-weight heterogeneity. They do not reveal which dominates on pretrained QKV. Four passive replay/capture forwards can measure that gap without changing model outputs.
decision.scope: Two already accepted artificial sigma0.5 development states, two heads, three attention calls and sixteen fixed image queries each. Use full rank, exact text support and fixed spatial selection. Require same-job baseline/capture byte equality and all frozen-source/input/conditioning receipts.
decision.limits: A successful capture measures operator approximation at these selected states only. It does not establish natural-trajectory behavior, quality, latency, generalization, resolution gains or novelty. Do not turn a favorable component error into automatic authorization for fused GPU kernels, a quality sweep or fresh64 use. Preserve every declared control and negative case.
decision.next_step: Parent may freeze and submit the bounded capture once the independent offline reporter and protocol checks are ready. No additional GPU test is needed merely to repeat these CPU identities.
